  satdata = data.frame(

#-------- get_dataset_max_date(dset) --------------
# Get max date of an ERDDAP dataset dset

get_dataset_max_date <- function(dset = "nesdisVHNSQchlaMonthly") {
  url <- paste0("https://coastwatch.pfeg.noaa.gov/erddap/tabledap/allDatasets.json?maxTime&datasetID=%22", dset, "%22")
  json_data <- fromJSON(url)
  
  time_str <- json_data$table$rows[1, 1]
  maxdate <- substr(time_str, 1, 10)
  
  return(maxdate)
}

# Function 1: getsaturl
getsaturl <- function(yr, mon, fmt, lgnd, satdata) {
  if (!is.null(satdata) && length(satdata) > 0) {
    satid <- NULL
    
    # Loop to find matching satellite data index
    for (i in seq_along(satdata$yrmax)) {
      if (yr <= satdata$yrmax[i] && yr >= satdata$yrmin[i]) {
        satid <- i
      }
    }
    
    if (is.null(satid)) {
      warning("No satellite dataset found matching the given year.")
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    erddata <- satdata[satid,]
    start_url <- "https://coastwatch.pfeg.noaa.gov/erddap/griddap/"
    
    # Format month to ensure leading zeros if passed as a single digit (e.g., "05" instead of "5")
    mon_str <- sprintf("%02d", as.numeric(mon))
    
    time_str <- paste0("[(" , yr, "-", mon_str, "-01T12:00:00Z)]")
    
    alt_str <- ""
    if (isTRUE(erddata$hasalt)) {
      alt_str <- "[(0.0)]"
    }
    
    loc_str <- "[(35):(20)][(-160):(-130)]&.draw=surface&.vars=longitude%7Clatitude%7C"
    end_str <- "&.colorBar=%7C%7CLinear%7C0%7C0.2%7C&.bgColor=0xffccccff&.trim=0"
    
    url <- paste0(
      start_url, erddata$dset, ".", fmt, "?", 
      erddata$varname, time_str, alt_str, loc_str, erddata$varname, end_str
    )
    
    if (lgnd != 1) {
      url <- paste0(url, "&.legend=Off")
    }
    
    return(url)
  }
}

# Function 2: getweeklyurl
getweeklyurl <- function(fmt, lgnd, satwkdata) {
  erddata <- satwkdata
  
  if (!is.null(erddata$dset)) {
    start_url <- "https://coastwatch.pfeg.noaa.gov/erddap/griddap/"
    time_str <- "[(last)]"
    
    alt_str <- ""
    if (isTRUE(erddata$hasalt)) {
      alt_str <- "[(0.0)]"
    }
    
    loc_str <- "[(35):(20)][(-160):(-130)]&.draw=surface&.vars=longitude%7Clatitude%7C"
    end_str <- "&.colorBar=%7C%7CLinear%7C0%7C0.2%7C&.bgColor=0xffccccff&.trim=0"
    
    url <- paste0(
      start_url, erddata$dset, ".", fmt, "?", 
      erddata$varname, time_str, alt_str, loc_str, erddata$varname, end_str
    )
    
    if (lgnd != 1) {
      url <- paste0(url, "&.legend=Off")
    }
    
    return(url)
  }
}

gettimes <- function(lastdate, months, satdata) {
  
  lastyear <- substr(lastdate, 1, 4)
  lastmon  <- as.numeric(substr(lastdate, 6, 7)) # 1-based index
  
  lastsaturl <- getsaturl(lastyear, lastmon, 'graph', 1, satdata)
  
  
  # Today's date calculations
  today <- Sys.Date()
  thisyear <- as.numeric(format(today, "%Y"))
  thismon  <- as.numeric(format(today, "%m")) # 1-based index
  
  # For Previous Blooms page
  nummon <- if (thismon > lastmon) lastmon else thismon
  
  defmonths <- list(
    list(id = "07", name = "Jul"),
    list(id = "08", name = "Aug"),
    list(id = "09", name = "Sep"),
    list(id = "10", name = "Oct")
  )
  
  newmons <- list()
  if (!is.null(months)) {
    for (i in seq_along(months$id)) {
      if (nummon >= as.numeric(months$id[i])) {
        newmons[[length(newmons) + 1]] <- defmonths[[i]]
      }
    }
  }
  thisyearmonths <- newmons
  
  # For About page
  imgtime <- "Most recent monthly composite of chlorophyll in the bloom region"
  curyr   <- thisyear
  
  if (thismon < 7) {
    curyr <- thisyear - 1
  }
  
  if (thismon < 7 || thismon == 12) {
    currentmonths <- defmonths
    imgtime <- paste0("Monthly composites of chlorophyll in the bloom region from the ", curyr, " bloom season")
  }
  
  if (thismon >= 7) {
    if (lastmon == 6) {
      currentmonths <- list(list(id = "06", name = "Jun"))
    } else if (lastmon < 6) {
      curyr <- thisyear - 1
      currentmonths <- defmonths
      imgtime <- paste0("Monthly composites of chlorophyll in the bloom region from the ", curyr, " bloom season")
    } else if (lastmon > 6) {
      curyr <- thisyear
      
      # Build slice of default months up to (lastmon - 6)
      max_idx <- min(lastmon - 6, length(defmonths))
      currentmonths <- if (max_idx >= 1) defmonths[1:max_idx] else list()
      
      imgtime <- paste0("Monthly composites of chlorophyll in the bloom region from the ", curyr, " bloom season")
    }
  }
  
  # Return all mutated state properties in a list
  return(list(
    lastsaturl     = lastsaturl,
    thisyear       = thisyear,
    thismon        = thismon,
    defmonths      = defmonths,
    thisyearmonths = thisyearmonths,
    imgtime        = imgtime,
    curyr          = curyr,
    currentmonths  = currentmonths
  ))
}
